detect: displacement irregularity, rail reaction divergence, video, inspection
action: Stop test, unload, inspect alignment/runner/rail; do not force through jam.

detect: 170 state channel + high-speed video + carriage motion
action: Immediate safe stop; isolate trigger and lock components; retain all raw data.

detect: force asymmetry, lateral reaction, visual deformation
action: Stop, inspect clevis/pin/fixture, repeat alignment verification before next run.

detect: travel sensor, force spike, video, permanent deformation
action: Hard stop test, quarantine damaged component, inspect stop/rail/carriage.
Inspect datum alignment, joint preload, rail friction and absorber match.

detect: DAQ audit, channel clipping, timebase comparison, calibration checks
action: Invalidate run for physical-input evidence; repair instrumentation and repeat.

detect: post-test dimensional survey and strain evidence where installed
action: Classify article as sacrificial or repairable; no reuse without review.
Replace/retorque per controlled procedure; do not silently reset.
